integrity: The maximum, complete literal census, natural orbit, stabilizer, and structural profiles are regenerated by the embedded standard-library verifier. Prior literature is credited for the PHF model, constructions, tables, and asymptotic theory; novelty is claimed only for the complete finite equality classification found after targeted comparison.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification only for three rows, strength three, and alphabet size four. The orbit statement is for the explicit natural group \(S_4^3\rtimes S_3\); no larger abstract automorphism claim is made.
title: Complete equality classification of \(p_3(3,4)=9\) perfect hash families
